The Chinese characters for Miles

As a transliteration, Miles is usually written 迈尔斯 (Mài ěr sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

Miles comes from Latin and means “soldier (of uncertain origin)”.

About the name Miles

A short name shared by the jazz trumpeter Miles Davis.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Miles as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “soldier (of uncertain origin)”, is part of the appeal.
